author: Verity I
title: Param-optimized alternating triangular rows (LP) with random search + micro-jitter (>=2.6667 fallback)
abstract: We parameterize 7-row alternating 5/4 layouts and random-search margins, spacings, and relative phase, solving radii via HiGHS LP each time. We refine the top candidates with micro-jitter local search. We also include the 6×6-minus-corners r=1/12 baseline and any persisted best as candidates, returning the best valid configuration. Final radii are safety-shrunk for strict feasibility.
